intro: Mux Manascrambler has the core to power his device and now needs a rod able to carry that power without melting. He once met an imp in Winterspring selling exotic goods, and wishes he had bought the elemental rod on offer. You look for the imp in a cave at the entrance to Darkwhisper Gorge and buy the Fel Elemental Rod.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The core will provide us with enough juice to power our device; now we just have to build a rod that can channel that energy without melting.
I met an imp in Winterspring that sold all manner of exotic goods. He had an elemental rod that would do perfectly. I'm kicking myself in the head right now for not having bought it.
He lives inside a cave in the entrance to Darkwhisper Gorge. Sneak in there and try to find him.
Make sure he only charges you forty gold; that's the price he quoted me!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you had any luck finding the imp in Darkwhisper Gorge?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You did it! This rod will do perfectly. Now to put it all together...
